title: Orchestral Ribbon: Workspace Wayfinding and Compact Panel Flow
creator: Aisha Mercer
description: Goal: Invent a compact, discoverable workspace switcher and sidebar orchestration that reduces time-to-task for multi-tenant users while surfacing per-route cost and rollout state. Background: Current console navigation is optimized for discovery but is heavy in vertical real-estate and separates workspace switching from per-workspace context (rollouts, cost lenses, routes). This ticket scopes a design prototype for an 'Orchestral Ribbon' — a horizontal ribbon that consolidates workspace switcher, active route breadcrumbs, and a compact rolling panel for rollouts/cost metrics. Scope: - Low-fidelity + high-fidelity prototypes for ribbon and compact panel (desktop and tablet) - Interaction patterns for switching workspaces without a full navigation context change (soft-switch) - Micro-animations for ribbon expand/collapse and persistent keyboard navigation - Cost & rollout affordances: per-route token cost quick peek, active rollout pill with canary toggle - Accessibility: keyboard-first flows, ARIA announcements for switches, 4.5:1 contrast for critical labels Excluded: mobile full-screen redesign (follow-up ticket), backend rollout toggles (ENG tickets to follow). Acceptance criteria: - Usability test median time-to-switch < 6s on lab tasks - Primary ribbon controls accessible by keyboard and screen reader with clear announcements - Visual design reviewed and approved by PM and engineering for implementability - Prototype demonstrates cost peek that does not require leaving current route Deliverables: - Figma prototype (desktop + tablet) with states and component variants - Clickable InVision link for moderated user tests - Handoff tokens and component specs for engineering - Design spec doc (Confluence) with acceptance criteria and QA checklist
ux_research_summary: Moderated usability tests planned (n=8) focusing on workspace switching and rollout discovery
Initial hallway tests (n=5) found users expect workspace switcher within 2 clicks and want a lightweight cost peek
proposed_solutions: Ribbon-first: persistent horizontal ribbon above content with compact workspace chips and route breadcrumbs
Panel-swap: transient compact panel that slides from the ribbon, multiplexing cost, rollout, and quick-actions
Soft-switch: non-disruptive workspace change that preserves local route context when possible
accessibility_notes: Tab order: ribbon → active route → panel toggle; Escape closes panel and returns focus to last ribbon element
Screen reader: announce workspace name + switch confirmation; announce rollout state changes
open_decisions: Should workspace chips show avatars or initials when > 8 workspaces? (prefers initials for density)
Can the soft-switch be implemented without backend session-scoping? Engineering to advise
risks: Engineering constraints may require a separate API for soft-switch session mirroring
Exposing token-cost at the route level could surface noise for new users and lead to support questions
